entities.summary: Thomas Ryan Pressly is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins, Houston Astros, and Chicago Cubs from 2013 to 2025. He also played for Team USA in the World Baseball Classic (WBC).
